title: GPU nodegroup autoscaler orchestration: Terraform module for Private VPC deployments
creator: Miguel Santos
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that authoritatively manages GPU-capable node groups for Private (VPC) deployments and their autoscaling behavior. The module should support both ASG-based and Karpenter-based scaling topologies, include healthchecks and upgrade hooks, and provide clear knobs for spot/ondemand mixing, taints/labels for scheduling, GPU driver and device-plugin bootstrap, and graceful node replacement strategies.
acceptance_criteria: Module instantiates GPU nodegroups in customer VPC with configurable instance types and capacity settings
Supports two orchestration modes via a single interface: legacy ASG + launch template and Karpenter provisioners
Automated GPU driver + nvidia device plugin installation via userdata or DaemonSet depending on provisioner
Health check policy that marks nodes for termination/drain after kernel/gpu-driver failure signals and exposes metrics for SLOs
Built-in upgrade strategy: canary AMI rollout for ASG and versioned provisioner hooks for Karpenter
Clear API for taints/labels, resource accounting, and node autorepair (recreate on unhealthy)
End-to-end test in private staging: deploy sample workload (dedicated GPU inference container), assert <150ms cold-start tail and stable throughput under 95th percentile latency
Documentation with migration steps from our existing gpu-nodepool module and example usage for private and hybrid clusters
implementation_notes: When 'asg' is selected, module creates Launch Template, ASG, requisite IAM role, and user-data bootstrap that installs NVIDIA drivers and docker runtime

When 'karpenter' is selected, module emits NodeTemplate/Provisioner-compatible tags and an optional bootstrap userdata for AMI baking; prefer DaemonSet for device-plugin installs to avoid userdata race conditions
Provide 'mixed_instances_policy' and 'spot_fallback' toggles for cost-aware node reclamation

Healthchecks: integrate EC2 instance status checks, kubelet readiness probes, and a custom SSM-based GPU health script that posts to CloudWatch. Add SNS alerting and a policy to cordon & drain failing nodes automatically

Upgrade path: support 'canary_percentage' for ASG rolling updates and a 'provisioner_version' pin for Karpenter; include a step to validate device-plugin and inference container on canary nodes before full rollout
Testing harness: re-use private-cluster CI job with a terraform plan/apply job, then run kubernetes conformance subset and a small perf harness using perfbench to validate latency/cold-starts
Edge cases: handle GPU instance types with ephemeral storage and large /dev/nvme mounts during image bake, coordinate with node lifecycle to avoid datastore corruption
IAM: least-privilege roles for autoscale controller and instance profile; ensure SSM, CloudWatch, ECR pull, and Karpenter specific tags are allowed
tasks: Draft module interface and variables schema
Prototype userdata and GPU-health SSM script
Implement ASG path: launch template, autoprovision hooks, and rolling update logic
Implement Karpenter path: provisioner resource outputs and node template artifacts
Add healthcheck CloudWatch metrics and automated cordon-and-drain lambda
Write Terraform integration tests for private staging cluster
Author migration guide and module examples
Create PR and request security/infra review
Coordinate with Ops to schedule private-stage rollout and monitor costs
